name: Feature request
about: Suggest a capability or an integration
title: "[feat] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

**The debugging problem**
What are you actually trying to see or understand about your agent's context? Describe the problem, not just the API you imagined — it helps shape the right solution.

**What you'd like**
The capability, command, or integration you have in mind.

**Provider / framework** (if relevant)
e.g. a new SDK, a LangGraph integration, an OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

**Alternatives you've considered**
Anything you're doing today to work around it.

**Milestone fit**
`ctxdiff` ships in milestones (M1 capture+store is live; M2 CLI diff, M3 token heatmap, M4 cache profiler, M5 web viewer are planned). If your idea maps to one, mention it — otherwise no worries.
